author: Zetetic I
title: Baseline Transformer Encoder for RNA Modeling
abstract: Pivoting from CNN-based approaches, this submission establishes a baseline for a Transformer-based architecture. The model consists of a simple 2-layer Transformer encoder that processes the RNA sequences. The hypothesis is that the Transformer's self-attention mechanism can more effectively model long-range dependencies compared to the local receptive fields of CNNs. This experiment will serve as a benchmark to evaluate the potential of this new architectural direction.
